reviews.text: Moved from another Vet hospital to this one. Very happy we did ! Everyone was nice and friendly and cared about the animals there very much. Explained everything in detail and made us comfortable and happy to now bring our babies there.
ALWAYS a positive experience with kind, caring staff! LOVEEEEE Dr. Melhus and EVERYONE in this office!
My pet and I both had great service with excellent staff. I would recommend Stonecrest Animal Hospital to everyone.
A Great Team of People that have shown excellent quality service for all of my Dogs through the years. Would recommend Stonecrest to anyone who wants top care for their pets.
The Vet and team were all wonderful. Everything was explained and everything was transparent.
Great staff and prices! Would definitely recommend!

I appreciate the smaller vets offices as they are more concerned with your pet and you actually get the same vet everytime. They can get to know your pet instead of getting bounced around to the vet of the day.  The vet actually read the files on my pets instead of pushing the treatment plan first then examining the pet.
It also doesnt take 45 minutes just to get a vaccine….and the vaccine is given in the treatment room not down the hall, then returned then wait for a consent form, then pay, etc etc.  My dogs actually get excited to go to vets!  More personal service which is hard to find and is important to me to have a relationship with one vet so they get to know my animals.

We’ve been taking Ella here since day one, and we’ve also had to make a couple of emergency visits. Every single time, the customer service has been amazing. The entire staff is caring, compassionate, and attentive, and they have always gone above and beyond to make sure Ella is taken care of and that all of our needs are met.

We truly appreciate the kindness and professionalism they show every time we walk through the door. We couldn’t be happier with the care Ella has received and would highly recommend them to anyone looking for a veterinary team they can trust! ❤️🐾
